output.summary: The shrink rise is mainly a receiving-control failure. Removing backdoor receiving clerks in 41 stores in April 2025 left DSD deliveries unverified. DSD categories account for 73% of the increase. Shrink rose to 3.0% in no-clerk stores versus 1.7% in clerk stores. An audit found a 4.9% invoice-to-count gap. A matched-control pilot cut DSD shrink from 4.4% to 1.9%. The count-firm artifact and associate theft are contradicted. District 4's bag checks and discipline memo found almost nothing and suppressed shortage claims. External theft and organized crime are real but small and confounded. Locked cases lose more margin than they save. Reinstate receiving now and verify with the DSD reconciliation. Run targeted urban checks (incident log, self-checkout non-scan audit) before any camera or LP spend.
